text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (July 18, 2024) for 68 Hillside Drive

The Property Standards Committee - Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (July 18, 2024) for 68 Hillside Drive, Folder Number 24 182807 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to January 17, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
